title: Friend with the same slit in his eye is a Raudive expert

tellings.quote: He's one of the world's leading experts on Constantine Roderve.

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber, who has long described his own encounters with beings he believes are not human, tells Michels about a friend in Marin County, California, who has the same odd slit in his eye that Strieber has. That friend, Strieber says, is "one of the world's leading experts" on Konstantin Raudive, a Latvian psychologist known for recording what he believed were voices of the dead on audio tape. Strieber offers the shared mark and the friend's field as one more strange link between people touched by these experiences.
